scenes.en: Signs, myths, surgery basics and glasses after surgery.
scenes.say: Is Appa's vision getting cloudy? In this video, we explain cataract in simple words: what it is, the signs, common myths, the basics of surgery, and glasses after surgery.

scenes.en: A clear lens behind the pupil focuses light, like a camera lens.
scenes.say: Behind the coloured part of your eye sits a natural lens. It is clear, like glass, and it focuses light onto the retina, just like a camera lens.

scenes.en: The lens slowly turns cloudy, like a foggy window.
scenes.say: With age, the proteins in this lens slowly clump together, and the lens becomes cloudy, like looking through a foggy window. That cloudiness is called a cataract. It is not a growth, or a skin over the eye.

scenes.en: Cataract is the leading cause of blindness worldwide (WHO).
scenes.ta: உலக அளவில் பார்வை இழப்புக்கு முக்கிய காரணம்
scenes.say: Did you know? According to the World Health Organization, cataract is the leading cause of blindness in the world. And yet, vision lost to cataract can usually be restored with surgery.

scenes.en: Mostly with age. Diabetes, smoking, strong sun and eye injury can bring it sooner.
scenes.ta: வயது, சர்க்கரை நோய், புகை, அதிக வெயில்
scenes.say: Most cataracts come with age, often after sixty, though they can start earlier. Diabetes, smoking, years of strong sunlight without protection, and eye injuries can make them come sooner.

scenes.en: Headlights look dazzling or starry.
scenes.say: Now, the signs. Sign one: glare. Headlights at night look dazzling or starry, and driving at night becomes difficult.

scenes.en: Vision looks hazy, as if the glasses are dirty.
scenes.say: Sign two: everything looks hazy, as if your glasses are dirty. You keep wiping them, but the haze does not go away.

scenes.en: Faded colours, needing more light to read, frequent power changes.
scenes.ta: நிறங்கள் மங்கும், படிக்க அதிக வெளிச்சம் தேவை
scenes.say: More signs: colours look faded or yellowish, you need more light to read, your glasses power keeps changing, or you see double with one eye.

scenes.en: Sudden vision loss, a painful red eye, or flashes and a curtain.
scenes.ta: திடீர் பார்வை இழப்பு, வலி – உடனே மருத்துவரை பாருங்கள்
scenes.say: Cataract usually changes slowly. So see an eye specialist urgently if your vision drops suddenly, if the eye is painful and red, or if you see flashes of light, or a curtain over your vision.

scenes.en: Fact: no need to wait. Surgery is planned when it affects daily life.
scenes.say: Now, some myths. Myth one: you must wait for the cataract to become ripe. Fact: with modern surgery, there is no need to wait. Surgery is usually planned when the cataract starts to affect daily life, like reading, driving, or walking safely.

scenes.en: Fact: no drop or diet removes a cataract. Surgery is the treatment.
scenes.say: Myth two: eye drops or home remedies can dissolve a cataract. Fact: no drop, diet or exercise can remove a cataract. Surgery is the only effective treatment.

scenes.en: Fact: it can't. A thin layer behind the new lens may haze later; a quick laser clears it.
scenes.say: Myth three: the cataract can grow back. Fact: once removed, it cannot come back. Sometimes, months or years later, a thin layer behind the new lens becomes hazy. This is easily treated with a quick laser procedure.

scenes.en: The cloudy lens is removed and a clear artificial lens is placed.
scenes.ta: மங்கிய லென்ஸை எடுத்து, புதிய தெளிவான லென்ஸ் வைப்பார்கள்
scenes.say: Now, the surgery basics. The eye surgeon removes the cloudy lens through a tiny opening, and places a clear artificial lens, called an intraocular lens, in its place. It stays there for life.

scenes.en: The eye is numbed. Most people go home the same day.
scenes.say: It is usually a short procedure. The eye is numbed, so it is not painful, and most people go home the same day. Usually, one eye is done at a time.

scenes.en: Monofocal: clear at one distance. Multifocal: less need for glasses.
scenes.say: Before surgery, talk to your surgeon about the type of lens. A standard monofocal lens is clear at one distance, usually far, so you will still need reading glasses. Multifocal or extended range lenses can reduce the need for glasses, but they are not right for every eye.

scenes.en: Use drops as advised. Don't rub. Wear the shield at night.
scenes.ta: கண்ணை தேய்க்காதீர்கள்; சொன்னபடி சொட்டு மருந்து போடுங்கள்
scenes.say: After surgery, use your eye drops exactly as advised, do not rub or press the eye, wear the shield while sleeping, and keep water and soap out of the eye for the first few days. Go for every follow-up visit.

scenes.en: Wait till the eye settles, usually a few weeks, then test for new glasses.
scenes.say: Now, glasses after surgery. Your power changes after cataract surgery, so your old glasses may not suit you. Wait until your surgeon says the eye has settled, usually a few weeks, and then get a fresh eye test for new glasses.

scenes.en: Reading glasses, or progressives for far, middle and near. Add UV protection.
scenes.say: With a standard lens, you may need reading glasses, or progressive lenses for far, middle and near in one pair. Choose lenses with an anti-glare coating and UV protection, and wear sunglasses outdoors.

scenes.ta: வீட்டிலேயே கண் பரிசோதனை – முழு குடும்பத்துக்கும் ரூ.100

scenes.en: Not a diagnosis. See an eye specialist for your own eyes.
scenes.ta: இது பொது தகவல் மட்டும் – கண் மருத்துவரை அணுகுங்கள்
scenes.say: This video is general information, not a diagnosis. For your own eyes, see an eye specialist. Share this with your parents, and subscribe for more eye-care tips.
